name: DijiHero
author: sientocreative

sections.description:
DijiHero is a stunning hero (welcome) section that sits at the top of your website. It captivates your users with background colors that change with mouse interaction (glow effect), scroll-linked animations, and floating word effects.

Features:
* Can be used anywhere with the [dijihero] shortcode. (Legacy [dijihero_legacy] is also supported).
* Fully responsive (mobile-friendly) design.
* Edit all texts, images, and links easily from the admin panel.
* Ability to toggle colors and animations on or off.
* Dynamically add or remove floating words.
* Lightweight and performance-optimized (No jQuery, No GSAP).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the DijiHero plugin file as a zip from the WordPress admin panel (Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to the “DijiHero” panel that appears in the left menu and configure your settings.
  4. Add the [dijihero] shortcode to any page where you want the hero section to appear.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor or Gutenberg?

Yes! You can simply place the [dijihero] shortcode inside any Shortcode widget or block.

Can I disable the animations?

Yes, you can easily toggle the glow effect, scroll animations, and floating words from the DijiHero settings panel.
